page.overview:
What is Gildis?

Gildis was an Edain woman of the House of Hador.

She was the wife of Hador Lórindol, the fifth Chieftain of the House of Marach (later known as "House of Hador" after her husband), and the mother of Glóredhel, her only daughter and eldest child, and sons Galdor and Gundor.

Gildis is not mentioned in any of the genealogy tables provided in The Silmarillion and Unfinished Tales, but only in a table provided in The War of the Jewels.
